scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run api:dev" "npm --workspace apps/web run dev"
scripts.db:migrate:create: cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate dev --create-only --name init
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.build:all: npm run db:generate && npm --workspace apps/web run build && npm --workspace apps/api run build
scripts.netlify:build: npm run db:generate && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.deploy:prepare: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate:deploy
